title: dichromena exaltata
intro: Dichromena exaltata, commonly known as Needle Flower or Feather Flower, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dichromena exaltata include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease pain, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
